name: Taskify
tagline: Kanban task management board with drag-and-drop lists and audit logs
description:
A clean Trello and Jira alternative featuring drag-and-drop card reordering, organization boards, Unsplash cover integration, activity audit logs, and Stripe subscription tiers.

Vibecoded with Next.js Server Actions and Prisma in a weekend experiment. Proved that full enterprise board mechanics don't require heavy single-page app frameworks.

replaces.note: Visual drag-and-drop boards and list reordering with zero seat restrictions.
Simple drag-and-drop boards without five configuration screens per ticket.
